name: Debugger Duck
tagline: Finds bugs by staring at them.
longDescription: Debugger Duck has spent years in late-night coding sessions and is famous for helping developers explain their problem out loud.

name: Sprint Duck
tagline: Always ready for the next standup.
longDescription: Sprint Duck keeps every backlog lively and insists that every sprint goal should include one tiny celebration.

name: Captain Quack
longDescription: Captain Quack navigates rough bubbles and tiny waves with confidence, charting safe routes for every floating companion.

name: Harbor Hero
longDescription: Harbor Hero patrols stormy tubs, always prepared with a tiny life ring and a reassuring squeak.

name: Pixel Quacker
longDescription: Pixel Quacker speaks in snippets and shortcuts, but always lands on clean, readable solutions.

name: Cloud Floater
longDescription: Cloud Floater loves distributed bath architecture and can replicate calm vibes across every corner of the water.

name: Sir Squeakalot
longDescription: Sir Squeakalot hosts elegant tea parties on floating trays and insists every guest leave with a compliment.

name: Duchess Drift
longDescription: Duchess Drift is known for flawless turns and dramatic entrances, accompanied by a tiny fanfare.

name: Campfire Quack
longDescription: Campfire Quack carries endless legends of hidden waterfalls and mysterious midnight ripples.

name: Trailblazer Duck
longDescription: Trailblazer Duck maps new routes through foam and mist, always returning with a new path for others.

name: Kavo Zahn Quack
longDescription: Kavo Zahn Quack keeps every bath-time operation on schedule, combining meticulous focus with a friendly bedside squeak.
